mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS shows no downward trend over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.3% in the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate profit expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.2 percentage points in the past month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 4.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both HOUST (demand) and RSAFS (demand) over the past month indicates robust demand growth, which boosts corporate earnings and positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and RSAFS increase in the past month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite both demand proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: During a 'monetary tightening cycle', a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 3.5% in the current month signals aggressive rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in the tightening cycle despite FEDFUNDS rising above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 105 in the past month signals stronger supply-side growth, which enhances corporate profit margins and positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises >0.5 in the past month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO exceeding 105.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 4.0% coupled with an increase in HOUST (demand) over the past month suggests improving labor market conditions and robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST increases in the past month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% and HOUST rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 over the past quarter signals strong demand growth, which drives corporate earnings and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 rising over the past quarter.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, a sustained increase in INDPRO above 105 in the current month signals strong supply-side momentum, which supports corporate profit growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in the late-cycle expansion despite INDPRO rising above 105.
